meta.label: Meta-analysis / systematic review
meta.caveat: Pools earlier studies. Only as strong as the studies it includes.

rct.label: Human RCT (placebo)
rct.caveat: Randomized against placebo: the strongest single-study design. Check the size and dose.

noplacebo.label: Human trial, no placebo
noplacebo.caveat: No placebo group, so expectation alone can explain part of the effect.

obs.label: Observational
obs.caveat: Shows a link, not cause and effect. People who choose cannabis can differ in other ways.

mice.label: Mice / rats only
mice.caveat: Animal results often do not carry over to people.

cells.label: Cells only (lab dish)
cells.caveat: Lab-dish results are an early lead, not evidence of a health effect.

review.label: Narrative review
review.caveat: An expert overview, not a systematic search. No new data.

case.label: Case report
case.caveat: One or a few patients. Useful for safety signals, not for effect.

papers.title: A phase II, randomised, placebo-controlled, double-blind trial of cannabis extract for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: the EMERALD trial.

plain.did: A randomized trial in 17 people compared a cannabis product with placebo.
plain.found: This trial did not achieve the target sample size therefore was underpowered to demonstrate efficacy of cannabis in slowing ALS progression. However, exploratory analyses generated hypotheses regarding possible effects on pain and cognition which require confirmation in adequately powered studies.
plain.caveat: Randomized against placebo: the strongest single-study design. Check the size and dose.

plain.caveat: Shows a link, not cause and effect. People who choose cannabis can differ in other ways.
